title: About Ajay Binay Institute of Technology (ABIT) Autonomous college
paragraphs: Ajay Binay Institute of Technology (ABIT) is approved by AICTE, affiliated with BPUT, and has been granted Autonomous Status by UGC. ABIT group operates an Engineering College and an Industrial Training Institute in Cuttack, Odisha.
The group was established in 1993 with the aim to improve the availability of skilled technical manpower for industries as well as to enhance reach of technical education to rural Odisha.

We are approved by AICTE, New Delhi, affiliated to Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Rourkela and NAAC accredited. ABIT has a balanced distribution of technical streams with equal emphasis on the core sector and IT sector.
